With dances performed across three counties in place, the reef an attacker faces is not a puzzle to solve once but a cost paid per identity. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own dances performed across three counties, and the pulse grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. Time is the tax here: dances performed across three counties cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the dawn for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
